pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with varying side counts and dimensions; edges exhibit moderate sharpness with defined pixel gradients between dark pigmentation and light corridors; patch density is high with large surface area relative to negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Contiguous network of light-colored pelage forming a topological grid; junction nodes are primarily tri-radial; corridor width is relatively narrow and uniform across the neck, showing slight increase in pixel thickness on the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the visible dorsal line of the neck; hair bundles create a rhythmic, jagged 1D contour against the blurred background.
